capability: Carry compiler-owned input validation evidence into immutable Preview and Build report issue details
searchEvidence: CodeGraph at e5202e2707d272076d24216222188d478314a07d identifies Application.CompiledInputLoadValidationEvaluator as the single existing evaluator consumed by CompiledInputArtifactInspectionService.ApplyInputLoadValidation and CompositionRunService.EvaluateInputLoad. The prior callers independently retain only CompositionIssue and must be extended, not re-evaluated or matched by code/message/operation.

CompositionRunService.ReadInputsAsync retains input-load errors in BoundInputs.Issues and warnings in BoundInputs.AdvisoryIssues; RunAsync creates final CompositionRunReport.Issues from the actual instances. CompositionRunReport is the path-free Preview/Build projection and already omits optional report facts with JsonIgnore(WhenWritingNull).

Owner-approved API: Application.Composition.InputDiagnosticEvidence carries AddressSpaceId, optional ActualLength/RequiredEndExclusive, optional ByteRange SourceRange, and optional RepeatedByte. Report InputDiagnostics use zero-based indexes into final Issues and must be immutable, unique, bounds-valid, and omitted when absent. The preflight independent architecture admission /root/review_ab_dp_metadata (GPT-5.6 Terra, high) approved extending this evaluator with first-failing candidate evidence only.
semanticOwner: Application.CompiledInputLoadValidationEvaluator owns the validation finding and typed evidence; CompositionRunService owns preservation of the exact CompositionIssue instance and report-index projection
terminalContract: The evaluator returns one immutable issue/evidence result for the first failing compiler-declared uniform input range. Inspector and runtime consume that same evaluation, retaining no raw source path or content beyond a repeated byte and declared offsets. A report records only evidence whose exact issue instance occurs once in its final Issues list, through a zero-based index and bound slot id; absent evidence serializes as absent. Input acceptance, severity, BlocksBuild, profiles, output bytes, names, execution order, and report creation outside real Preview/Build remain unchanged.

designReview.evidence: GPT-5.6 Terra/high preflight approved the Application-owned single-evaluation, immutable-evidence, additive-report design; it rejected UI re-derivation and changes to acceptance/severity/BlocksBuild.
